items.title: Trump names national intelligence chief Jay Clayton as new AI czar
items.excerpt: Trump said DNI Jay Clayton will lead the White House's new 'Super Intelligence Force,' which will coordinate government engagement with AI companies; follows last week's voluntary AI accord. (Off-list: on-list Axios is bot-walled.)

items.title: An AI Accord, a New Czar and an Autonomous Warfare Command
items.excerpt: Weekly policy roundup: the White House's voluntary AI accord with frontier labs, the new AI czar, and a Pentagon autonomous-warfare command.

items.title: U.S. Leads International Coalition to Endorse Kyoto Vision for a Golden Age of Science
items.excerpt: Primary release: at the STS Forum in Kyoto, the U.S. and 16 countries endorsed a joint declaration led by OSTP's Michael Kratsios to harness 'super intelligence' for autonomous experimentation and new research funding models.

items.title: Rural Data Centers Are in for a Big Federal Tax Break
items.excerpt: Under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, AI data center projects in rural areas could qualify for major tax benefits starting next year; some hyperscalers seem reluctant to take the money.

items.title: Pennsylvania is a Swing-State Case Study for Data Center Politics
items.excerpt: Why Pennsylvania communities are resisting AI data centers, and how the siting fight is shaping swing-state politics ahead of the midterms.

items.title: NJ's former lieutenant governor resigned over a sexual harassment investigation, but insists AI says he's innocent
items.excerpt: NJ's former lieutenant governor Dale Caldwell, who resigned amid a sexual harassment investigation, says an AI analysis shows he is innocent.

items.title: 이억원 "AI활용 해킹 가능성…금융권 최고수준 경각심 가져야"(종합)
items.excerpt: 금융위원장이 최근 시중은행 등 금융권 해킹·정보유출 사태에 AI 에이전트 활용 가능성을 언급하며 최고 수준의 경각심과 대응을 주문. 이재명 대통령도 철저 조사 지시.

items.title: [테크톡노트] AI는 왜 'SI'가 됐나…트럼프가 이름 바꾼 이유
items.excerpt: 트럼프 행정부가 행정명령으로 '인공지능(AI)' 대신 '슈퍼 인텔리전스(SI)'라는 용어를 채택한 배경과 정책적 함의 해설.

items.title: US arrests tech CEO accused of smuggling $300M in Nvidia chips into China
items.excerpt: DOJ charged a California tech CEO with routing $300M of export-controlled Nvidia AI servers to China; Nvidia's chip-smuggling problem persists as arrests continue.

items.title: U.S. appeals court blocks Minnesota law barring 'nudified' photos in xAI lawsuit
items.excerpt: The 8th Circuit enjoined Minnesota's first-in-the-nation ban on AI 'nudification' tools while xAI's First Amendment challenge proceeds; AG Ellison vows to defend it. (Off-list: no on-list outlet covered the ruling.)

items.title: Third Circuit affirms in Thomson Reuters v. ROSS: The Court Gets Merger Wrong and Does a Disservice to Fair Use
items.excerpt: The first federal appellate ruling on fair use in AI training: the Third Circuit held ROSS's use of Westlaw headnotes to train an AI legal research tool was not fair use, leaving generative AI questions open. (Off-list.)

history_match.title: Federal appeals court upholds Thomson Reuters' landmark AI copyright win

items.title: Arizona court tosses sentence in road rage case over AI victim video
items.excerpt: An Arizona appeals panel ruled that letting an AI-generated video of the deceased victim be shown at sentencing 'constituted fundamental error,' vacating the sentence. (Off-list AP wire.)

items.title: China has cracked down on AI relationships. Is it ahead of the game?
items.excerpt: CSET item on China's crackdown on AI companion and relationship chatbots, and whether Beijing is ahead of other regulators. Excerpt from title/feed only; body not yet verified.

items.title: What America and China Fear Most About AI
items.excerpt: CSET piece (podcast/commentary) comparing the AI risks that U.S. and Chinese policymakers each prioritize. Excerpt from title/feed only; body not yet verified.

items.title: Who gets to decide if AI is safe? Africa wants a say
items.excerpt: At the UN Security Council, African nations warned against becoming a testing ground for foreign AI models and demanded a direct voice in global AI standards.

items.title: Russia's AI Law Puts Control Ahead of Capability
items.excerpt: An examination of Russia's first comprehensive AI law, its rushed passage, and what its state-control priorities mean for AI development.

items.title: Trump's Crazy AI Rebrand Was a Loyalty Test for Tech Execs—and It Worked
items.excerpt: WIRED Backchannel: for years tech billionaires talked about 'AI' constantly, but they went along quietly when Trump's order dropped the term in favor of 'super intelligence.'

items.title: Some topics are off limits inside popular Chinese-made free AI, researchers find
items.excerpt: Researchers found Alibaba's Qwen refuses or parrots state doctrine on politically sensitive topics, raising questions as Chinese open models spread globally. (Off-list.)

items.title: Power approval set to delay Oracle's Wisconsin AI datacenter
items.excerpt: Grid connection for Oracle's Wisconsin AI datacenter awaits state regulatory approval, putting planned 2027 delivery at risk.
